item.description: Petrostates blocked ambition while wealthy nations withheld cash support. The climate crisis demands the next UN summit turns promises into action In a negotiation the maxim is usually that no deal is better than a bad deal. But the failure of Cop31 in Turkey to get a climate pact – the first time this has happened in 17 years – should not be an excuse for leaving the planet with the damaging status quo. A hard bargain needs a credible route to agreement: by making commitments, seeking concessions and getting others to reciprocate. This did not happen at the weekend. Responsibility for the breakdown lay principally with petrostates resisting a transition away from fossil fuels and wealthy nations that are unwilling to finance it properly. In GTA VI, Rockstar has created the most extraordinarily, indulgently detailed virtual world that we have yet seen.
